objective: Substantial recovery of visible-ball stoppages without any increase in false D or primary-score regression.
selection_history: The original substantial-primary-gain criterion (buffered +.04 and gains in other protocols) remains unchanged and none of the ownership/transition/context screens met it. This separate explicitly adaptive secondary-objective plan is motivated by weak-context heads improving real D recall while preserving primary scores. It must not be described as passing the initial primary-gain criterion.
recipe: Keep all anchored models/ownership unchanged. Fit the two frozen context_weak/context_restart_weak heads with weak mass.5, same features, targets and settings as STOPPAGE_CONTEXT_PLAN. Independently apply STOPPAGE_HYSTERESIS_PLAN low.5/high.8,min50,extension125 to each head; take max of the two priors and anchored D; compose with anchored conditional ownership and decode penalty3. No new thresholds or tuning after this freeze.
weak_exclusion: Entire public region with250-frame buffer and all24 reserved annotation windows with250-frame buffers excluded from weak fitting. Only original labels at eligible public training indices are supervised; weak labels are fallible algorithmic proxies from other observations, never corrected target labels.

promotion.every_pair: stitched spellF1>=reference, MacroF1>=reference+.005, false D frames<=reference, D recall>=reference+.05, no extra mostly missed stoppages, no previously mostly recovered short run becomes mostly missed, short-live mean recall>=reference.
promotion.stoppage_recovery: For every buffered-minute and longer-block seed, zero mostly missed stoppages; all purged checks must also keep zero.
promotion.selection: Only one candidate; if any check fails keep anchored default. Record all block regressions and complete diagnostics. If it passes, claim substantial stoppage-recall gains only; report buffered primary gain as measured, including zero.

interpretation: Adaptive same17-public-possession development with dependent seed/protocol checks. Neither the new weak labels nor repeated checks establish independent or full-match accuracy. Nothing submitted, published or uploaded.
